cards.hint: Think about lab testing with moving air
options: by reading cockpit gauges in flight
cards.quote: Drag coefficients are almost always determined experimentally using a wind tunnel.
cards.stem: How are drag coefficient values most often obtained

cards.hint: Recall what about the air itself matters
options: the color of the outer paint
cards.quote: Drag depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity, the air’s viscosity and compressibility
cards.stem: Which air property is listed as affecting drag

cards.hint: Look for the single variable name for drag
cards.quote: For drag, this variable is called the drag coefficient, designated “Cd.”
cards.stem: What name is given to the single variable for drag effects

cards.hint: Focus on how the area term is labeled
cards.quote: Notice that the area (A) given in the drag equation is given as a reference area.
cards.stem: How is the area term in the drag equation described
